blocks.content: Have you ever wondered how websites remember your preferences, like dark mode or items in your cart, even after you leave?
The secret lies in browser storage: websites save small pieces of data in your browser to create a personalized experience.
In this chapter, you'll learn how browser storage works and how to use it effectively.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
